notes: Focused IEEE 1516.2-2025 public-API Attribute-table witness. Public Create accepts schema-valid Value Required=false on an unshared attribute and =true on a published attribute, accepts a partial row omitting Value Required, and rejects sharing=Neither/valueRequired=true as InconsistentFOM. The same FOM supplies all four Ownership values (Divest, Acquire, DivestAcquire, NoTransfer) and all four Sharing values (Publish, Subscribe, PublishSubscribe, Neither), and successful public creation directly covers §6.2.5 p. 92 l. 66, l. 70, and l. 74. The separate true-plus-Neither rejection tests the Table 10 consistency rule. The older pinned candidate has only clause-4 provenance (RL-052); omission does not establish a default value. FOM and logical-time configuration are adapter-owned. Installed-package C++ and Java runtime outcomes are recorded separately. No ownership-transfer semantics, per-federate declaration-state evidence, exhaustive malformed-value matrix, interoperability, or conformance claim.
